title: ADDCOLUMNS keeps every row and gives the expression a row context only: an aggregate needs CALCULATE to see the row

source.quote: -- New columns are computed in the row context of ADDCOLUMNS, -- you need to invoke context transition to generate a filter -- context, if needed.
source.supports: the page shows the same pair of columns: the bare SUM repeats the grand total

source.quote: A table with all its original columns and the added ones.

derivation: Total quantity is 15, and a bare SUM ignores the row context, so 15 on every row. With CALCULATE the colour of the row becomes a filter: Red rows 1, 2, 3, 5, 7 = 1 + 2 + 1 + 2 + 1 = 7; Blue rows 4, 6 = 5 + 3 = 8; Green none, BLANK. Green stays in the result.
